channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: 'Tom Cruise' and 'Brad Pitt' fight over Epstein in viral AI video created with new Chinese tool
item.description: Seedance 2.0, a realistic video generation tool from ByteDance, the Chinese parent company of TikTok, is turning heads and raising copyright concerns.

item.title: 6 of the best and 5 of the worst looks at New York Fashion Week 2026
item.description: Fall and winter shows are underway at New York Fashion Week. Celebrities are attending in a mix of stunning outfits and ensembles that miss the mark.

item.title: US Army leaders say soldiers are drowning in so much battlefield data that AI is needed to make sense of it all
item.description: Personnel won't be able to fully process all the data available on the modern battlefield. That's where artificial intelligence applications come in.

item.title: Meta says it won't chop the bottom 5% performers this year
item.description: Meta, led by CEO Mark Zuckerberg, says it will not conduct new performance-based layoffs, shifting from last year's 5% workforce reduction.

item.title: Who is North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's daughter, Kim Ju Ae, and why is she appearing more in the media?
item.description: Little is known about Kim Ju Ae, but recent appearances with dad Kim Jong Un fueled questions about whether she may be the next to lead North Korea.

item.title: Creator-economy unicorn LTK lays off staff as it doubles down on its new marketing tech for brands
item.description: Creator-affiliate platform LTK, backed by SoftBank, let go of some staff as it reorganizes its team and bets on a new marketing tool for brands.

item.title: I used to be proud of only sleeping 3 hours because I worked so much. Now I realize health is freedom, not wealth.
item.description: After years of extreme work and little sleep, a founder explains how health data revealed hidden risks and pushed him to rethink success.

item.title: Gary Marcus calls out viral AI essay as alarmist 'hype'
item.description: AI researcher Gary Marcus said Matt Shumer's viral essay, "Something Big Is Happening," oversells the current capabilities of AI models.

item.title: Meta apparently thinks we're too distracted to care about facial recognition and Ray-Bans
item.description: Meta's Ray-Ban Smart Glasses could be equipped with facial recognition, and an internal memo reportedly says we're all too distracted to care.

item.title: Alexander brothers testimony describes a woman being sexually assaulted in a Hamptons hot tub as partygoers watched
item.description: Southampton partygoers watched or joined in as an "intoxicated" woman was attacked in a hot tub by two Alexander brothers, a witness testified.
